baseline: original interp checkpoints, validation only, no retraining
changed_variable: shape-branch anchor-conditioned phase resampling; phase_p / phase_pd
actual_seed: 42 + physical fold, identical to original dual-head runners
initialization: from scratch, original architecture construction then new shape input conv; no pretrained/final checkpoint initialization
checkpoint: same frozen hmean of val shape arithmetic PCC and independent macro F1@100ms, tie shape PCC then -RMSE
schedule: zero-based epochs [0,15) reference, [15,45) blend, [45,100) prediction; invalid training pair -> reference only during training
eval: always predicted anchors, no filtering fallback/unmatched; oracle on frozen selected checkpoint only

gate.cross_case_aggregation: equal-weight arithmetic mean across three development folds; report each separately, author confirmed
